name: Mean Dolphin 53
author: JOBOYA
description: Outlined gray checkbox that toggles on and off when clicked.
howItWorks: On hover, transform becomes translateX(-20px) translateY(-2px) rotate(10deg), box-shadow becomes 0 4px 6px #000000. Clicking it toggles it: background-color changes to #666, border-color becomes #666, top becomes 50%.
